defects.page offset: OFFSET is page * 20 with pages starting at 1, so page 1 skips the first 20 invoices.
defects.refund IDOR: refund never checks that the invoice belongs to the signed-in user, so any user can refund anyone's invoice.
defects.double refund race: The refunded check and the UPDATE are not atomic, so concurrent requests can refund the same invoice twice.
defects.timing-unsafe HMAC: The signature is compared with != instead of a constant-time comparison (timing attack).
